thesis.core: Import-substitution and EV-driven content-per-vehicle expansion in precision forgings; capacity doubling commissioning over the next 4 quarters against a >2x revenue order book.
thesis.catalysts: New plant ramp, two large export contract wins, PLI-linked customer additions.
thesis.whatMustGoRight: Plant ramps on schedule and margins hold as fixed costs are absorbed; export demand does not soften.
thesis.risks: Cyclical auto demand, raw-material (steel) price swings, customer concentration, execution slippage on capex.
thesis.invalidation: Two consecutive quarters of OPM contraction >300bps, order book falling below 1x revenue, promoter pledge appearing, or close below the 200-DMA on rising volume.

thesis.core: Niche fluorination chemistry with a customer-validated moat; structural shift of global supply chains toward India (China+1) supports multi-year volume growth.
thesis.catalysts: New molecule approvals, multi-year supply agreements, debottlenecking adding capacity at low capex.
thesis.whatMustGoRight: Working capital normalises as growth scales; new molecules clear regulatory/customer qualification on time.
thesis.risks: Rising working-capital intensity, customer/end-market concentration, pricing pressure if competitors add capacity.
thesis.invalidation: OCF/PAT falling below 0.5 for a full year, debt/equity above 1.0, or loss of an anchor customer.

thesis.core: Indigenisation of defence electronics with a rising order book; small base means modest absolute order wins move earnings materially.
thesis.catalysts: Order finalisations, indigenisation policy push, possible JV/technology-transfer announcements.
thesis.whatMustGoRight: Order execution converts to cash; working-capital build does not choke the balance sheet; pledge does not rise.
thesis.risks: Lumpy government ordering, long receivable cycles, low liquidity (exit risk), pledge already at 8% and bears watching.
thesis.invalidation: Pledge rising above 25%, OCF turning negative for a year, order book stalling, or entry into ASM/GSM.

thesis.core: Distribution-led premiumisation in tier-2/3 towns; a steady compounder rather than an explosive re-rating story — included on the watchlist to monitor for a better technical entry.
thesis.catalysts: New SKU launches, distribution expansion, margin recovery if input costs ease.
thesis.whatMustGoRight: Volume growth re-accelerates and valuation (PEG 2.5) is justified by a faster earnings ramp.
thesis.risks: Rich valuation with modest growth, competitive intensity, technical downtrend (below 50-DMA).
thesis.invalidation: Earnings growth slipping below 10%, market-share loss, or a decisive break of the 200-DMA.
